mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening residential construction activity, which correlates with improved consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods where HOUST rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 0.5%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces borrowing costs and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods where PAYEMS growth > 0.3% and UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a growth regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of periods where INDPRO < 100 during a growth regime.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225) indicates persistent price pressures that prompt central bank tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 225.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 400,000, it signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods where RSAFS > 400000.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST) combined with robust retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based consumer and housing sector recovery, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of periods where HOUST > 690 and RSAFS > 400000.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 8.0%), weak labor market conditions suppress consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of periods where UNRATE > 8.0%.
